trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableStatus: Possibly missable: the balcony window is known; its necessity for the trophy is unconfirmed.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx’s spot guide labels the balcony session missable [S3]. The PowerPyx roadmap and GTABase call the trophy itself only possibly missable because whether the balcony session is required remains unconfirmed [S2][S4]. Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations tracks the sessions separately from the PS5 trophy [S3][S4].
trophies.steps:
1. Chapter 1 after Down to Earth: follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept the prompt [S3].
2. Keep a separate Chapter 1 save before advancing the story [S3].
3. Log 18 meditation actions across 10 spots in the Meditations tracker [S3].
4. Complete Ascent on Mount Kalaga after the other 17 meditations [S3].
trophies.where: Home balcony first; purple meditation markers across Leonida [S3]
trophies.timing: Do the balcony session before Chapter 1 ends; its requirement is unconfirmed [S2][S4].
